title: NFL's new three-strike system doesn't apply until the 2026 regular season

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFL's new three-strike system doesn't apply until the 2026 regular season
sources.description: The NFL and the NFL Players Association have agreed to a new three-strike formula that will trigger automatic suspensions for repeated violations of five specific safety rules: hip-drop tackles, horse-collar tackles, launching, hits on defenseless players, and blindside blocks.
